notes: Identity assessment: canonical text identifies Source: https://osf.io/ybzev and is a full 13-page primary replication Final Report - Stage 1 and Stage 2, dated 17th November 2020. Title: Replication of a Research Claim from Ihme & Tausendpfund (2018), from The Journal of Experimental Political Science. Its original citation matches the neutral original title, volume 5(1), pages 39-55 (2018 print year versus supplied 2017). Replication team: Flávio Azevedo, Deliah Bolesta, Leticia Micheli. Azevedo and Micheli overlap the supplied replication citation, but other authors and date differ from its 2025 project reference. Source URL matches supplied url_r; ref_r instead mentions osf.io/8feku. This is a related primary final report; exact cited version identity is not fully established. No PDF supplied. Original side and replication n are unassigned placeholders. Blank replication locator, null study and null description leave Stage 1 versus cumulative Stage 1 and Stage 2 unspecified. Claim Summary specifies the political-interest-adjusted interaction, labelled H2 [focal test for SCORE] at both stages. Stage 1 H2 candidate: printed Cohen’s f^2 = .002, F(2, 658) = .691, p = .501 (p. 4, Table 1.3 narrative). Cumulative Stage 1 and Stage 2 H2 candidate: printed Cohen’s f^2 = .002, F(2, 1489) = 1.216, p = .297 (p. 8, Table 2.3 narrative). No candidate selected or merged; matching effect-size numbers do not resolve correspondence. Unadjusted H1 tests also appear on pp. 2 and 7, but Claim Summary identifies the adjusted H2 as focal. Both stage-specific author verdicts explicitly say unsuccessful, supporting failed independently of stage ambiguity. No N arithmetic or effect conversion performed.
